title: Qt: traffic tables - tcp/udp port name resolution
description:
Allow conversation/endpoint tabs that include IP address and
port number to resolve either or both. Currently IP address
(network) resolution is required to resolve tcp/udp ports.

notes.body: This should include `"sctp"` as well. (Also, for more obsolete protocols that do still have tabs and are affected by the global name resolution settings, this line and the previous should include `dccp` and the previous line should have `ipx`.)

Thanks for this rabbit hole. :-)  Working through sample captures now.  
  
The Bluetooth samples on the wiki include a few packets with mac addresses as Bluetooth protocol.  
Should `bluetooth` be added to the `mac_protos`?

You can only include values here, where the corresponding field has been filled. It may not be the case for every protocol, should only be implemented for those that have explicit endpoint configurations.

Only protocols that have called `register_conversation_table` from `epan/conversation_table.h` use this model.

In this function, this is for protocols that the name resolution globals affect, which is implemented in `epan/addr_resolv.c`

The only ones that have ports displayed are ones for which the `hide_ports` boolean is FALSE when `register_conversation_table` is called.

Port resolution is applied to TCP, UDP, SCTP, and DCCP ports, and that's relatively simple because you only have to look at those protocols.

Many protocols have IP addresses or MAC addresses, but not all protocols register conversation tables.

I've made the code change and need to make a test pass through. `wpan` and `zbee_nwk` will change to "-" (N/A).
